title: Client Connector profiles and install command, ZDX probe setup, fleet health and the strict ZCC evaluation
standards: OWASP Top 10 2021 A01 A02 A03 A04 A06 A09 A10

coverage.note: coverage.py combined line+branch over the five files, with their existing tests plus tests/test_c6_zcc_zdx.py; after: lines 0.927, branches 0.863.

checks.what: The forwarding profile is created first and the app profile links to its new id
A refused app profile deletes the new forwarding profile again
An app-profile re-read that fails before the write also rolls back the forwarding profile
A refused rollback keeps the forwarding profile on record so Undo deletes it
A forwarding profile linked by any app profile, on any platform and by any spelling of the id, is never deleted
A platform whose app profiles cannot be read blocks the delete
A profile that came into use or was enabled after the preview is left alone
No build body carries a password, with every setting ticked; a spec cannot add one
Windows install values with cmd.exe or PowerShell metacharacters are double-quoted
Typographic quotes, control, format and separator characters and non-text values are refused
macOS values are single-quoted for /bin/sh
Tokens and passwords are masked in the command, the script and the parameters unless revealed
The policy token never reaches the Python log or the audit log
A token read that fails answers in plain words without echoing the exception; a non-numeric id is refused before any call
Endless lists stop at the page cap with an error; Stop sends nothing more
Custom app URLs: scheme, credentials, whitespace, port, length and host name are checked
Loopback, link-local (metadata), unspecified, multicast, reserved, *.localhost and numeric-tail hosts are refused
IDN hosts are sent as punycode; private and IPv6 addresses are accepted
A custom app whose setup fails half way is removed, probes first (CloudPath before Web)
After Stop nothing more is sent and the app left behind is logged and kept for Undo
An id of . or .. is refused and never sent as a path segment
The ZDX configuration API paths stay marked as assumed in the module and in every plan
Every ZDX refusal shape and status has one plain sentence; executor exceptions never escape
Versions compare semantically (4.7 == 4.7.0, 4.10 > 4.9) and a hostile version cannot crash int()
Registration, device type and service states read as int, text, float or DEVICE_TYPE_{OS}
Large fleets are counted completely, rows kept are capped, pagination and the page cap hold, a failed page shows no partial figures
The service-status CSV is size-capped and parsed defensively; exports neutralise formulas
The drift view masks secret values, also inside lists
No strict-evaluation finding repeats a password value
Profile inventories reject repeated pages, short totals, bad items and error bodies; failures are kept per platform

findings.title: Install command left values with PowerShell/cmd metacharacters unquoted, and typographic quotes closed PowerShell strings
findings.fix: Quote every Windows value outside a bare-safe set; refuse U+2018-U+201F, control/format/separator characters and non-text values.

findings.title: ZDX custom app URL accepted loopback, link-local (cloud metadata), unspecified, multicast and reserved addresses and numeric-tail hosts
findings.fix: clean_url refuses those addresses (also IPv4-mapped), *.localhost and hosts ending in a number; private addresses stay allowed.

findings.title: A ZDX probe accepted without an id left the half-built custom app behind (rollback deleted a probe with id None, or skipped it)
findings.fix: Probes accepted without an id are looked up on the app by name and removed with it.

findings.title: After Stop, the half-built ZDX app left behind was not named in the run log
findings.fix: The stop branch of the rollback logs the app it did not remove and that Undo removes it.

findings.title: ZDX ids of '.' or '..' passed validation and would have been sent as a path segment
findings.fix: Dot-only ids are refused in the spec, and ZdxApi.send refuses any dot segment before the executor.

findings.title: A 5000-digit version part raised ValueError (int string limit) in the fleet and version-spread checks
findings.fix: version_tuple reads at most four parts of at most nine digits from the first 200 characters.

findings.title: Versions 4.7 and 4.7.0 compared unequal, so devices on one release showed as version drift
findings.fix: version_tuple pads to four parts so trailing zeros compare equal.

findings.title: Device type, registration and app-profile platform codes as floats or DEVICE_TYPE_{OS} read as unknown; 'Darwin' read as Windows
findings.fix: One code_text normaliser for numbers, floats and DEVICE_TYPE_ prefixes; Apple names matched before 'win' at a word start.

findings.title: The forwarding-profile in-use check compared link ids as raw text (7001.0 or ' 7001 ' did not match 7001)
findings.fix: Ids and links are normalised (_ref) before every comparison.

findings.title: Secret values held in a list were shown in the profile drift view
findings.fix: mask_settings masks every scalar of a list under a secret key.

findings.title: IDN hosts in ZDX custom app URLs were refused instead of being sent as punycode
findings.fix: Non-ASCII hosts are IDNA-encoded and the URL rebuilt with the ASCII host.

findings.title: Fleet analysis of 200 000 devices took about 38 s (field names re-normalised for every lookup)
findings.fix: Field-name normalising is cached and each device's fields are indexed once (about 12 s).

notes: ZDX probes run on the enrolled devices, never from this app, so private (RFC 1918, ULA) and internal hosts stay valid ZDX targets; only addresses that name no app are refused.
The ZDX configuration API paths are not in zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 and stay marked ASSUMED (module docstring, CONFIG comment and every plan's notes).
